svg.aria-label: What code-node's plugins find together in examples/cart-service: its SAM template, the Lambda platform and its libraries read one entry point, and together they find a role that doesn't allow two AWS calls, two unset variables, SQL injection, a client with no timeout, a connection on every call and a query run once per item.
svg.title: What code-node's plugins find together in examples/cart-service: its SAM template, the Lambda platform and its libraries read one entry point, and together they find a role that doesn't allow two AWS calls, two unset variables, SQL injection, a client with no timeout, a connection on every call and a query run once per item.
svg.text: PutItem and Publish: its role doesn't allow them
DELETE built from the request: SQL injection
No timeout: Lambda stops it at 15 s
A new connection on every call
SELECT runs once per item in the cart
